events.title: Announcement: Playtest Is Closing!
events.summary: The playtest will close on October 1, 2026! Many bugs in the playtest will no longer be fixed – compared to the demo, the game's internal code has undergone major changes, making it difficult to maintain two significantly different versions. Although the demo content is part of the full version, the playtest's story will be adjusted and optimized, and will be merged into the full version in the future. —— If you have any further feedback, please leave a comment or send it to Takokun@qq.com. THX

events.title: Playtest Coming Soon！
events.summary: We originally planned to release a demo in May and join the June Next Fest, but due to the workload being larger than expected, we’ve decided to open a Playtest first — no sign-up required, just download and play.The main goals of this test are to test the system UI and character development. Unlike the demo, we’ve created a new short story for the Playtest version.The Playtest is expected to be available sometime in May. Stay tuned! ————THXTakokun Studio

events.title: The official store page has been updated!
events.summary: The original store description has been moved to the demo page, and the demo is expected to be released publicly in May this year! In addition to text changes, this update also includes localization of the text in the store screenshots into English, Simplified Chinese, Russian, and Japanese. As the game's content continues to improve, new screenshot assets will likely be added or replaced in the future!

events.title: 🎉 We hit 100 wishlists in 10 days! 🎉
events.summary: Thank you all so much! 100 wishes from 18 countries/regions including China, Russia, Japan, US, Canada, India, Pakistan, Poland, Vietnam, Korea, Estonia, Uzbekistan, Germany, Brazil, France, UK, Singapore, and Greece!Seeing players from all over the world interested in our game is the best feeling ever. We'll keep working hard to make it worth your wait!If you're curious about the game, feel free to ask questions in the comments – we read every single one.On to the next milestone! 🚀
